Edge one: a new command Service.CompleteFraming in the EXISTING file internal/application/framing.go issues domain.RequirementReadyCommand from domain.RequirementFraming -- owner or scheduler via callerActor, idempotent by request_id through s.mutate/u.Idempotency/restoreResponse, gated by ONE domain.Permit of kind domain.PermitClaim with nothing passed to domain.EffectFromPermit, ControlTarget and revision resolved INSIDE the transaction from u.RequirementRepositoryLink and domain.EffectiveControl, At from transactionAuthorityTime, event type requirement.ready, and NO OutboxItem -- reachable over one new route POST /v1/requirements/{requirement_id}:complete-framing added to internal/api/api.go's POST default branch by the existing prefix-plus-suffix idiom with one new suffix constant, and declared in contracts/openapi/openapi-v1.yaml as operationId completeRequirementFraming. The measured before/after is a set: the Requirement statuses reachable through the application layer go from {captured, framing, needs-input, ready} to exactly {captured, framing, needs-input, ready, active}. ROW 2 -- WHAT IT DELIBERATELY DOES NOT DO. internal/domain is byte-unchanged (tree object 84cc02df13e12b818380ebc64af40d730bb19c4b before, and re-measured after): no RequirementCommandKind, no RequirementStatus, no PermitKind, no previous-status field, no resume command, and no allowed() list changes, because model.go:480-484 already admits RequirementReadyCommand from framing and model.go:485-489 already admits RequirementStart from ready. (a) The FIVE transitions this task does not issue, each with the measurement that blocks or refuses it, are recorded in the a13-* checks: pause, cancel, wait, recover, and evaluate/CompleteRequirementFromRelease. (b) Claim still succeeds against a parent Requirement in captured and leaves it in captured; measured and LOGGED for the tech_lead (18 test files across FOUR packages -- not five -- call Claim), not asserted, because asserting a defect pins it in place and turns its repair into a failure in files a repairing task may not own; that is the F1 follow-on. Edge two is built so it works when a caller does exist; the reachability defect belongs to V2-091. (d) internal/runner/orchestrator.go still carries an Increment through Plan, Prepare, Claim and Start; after edge two lands it will also carry its parent, but only when the parent is in ready, and RunFakeJourney never frames its Requirement, so its parent stays captured and its journey test is untouched. (f) internal/store/firestore's suite prints ok while skipping everything without an emulator; the figure is recorded WITH ITS PATTERN in the a21-* checks and never counted as a pass (G7). ROW 4 -- THIS TASK PASSES NO RELEASE GATE. Exactly three evidence records are issued (application, api, contracts), result and release_eligible are recorded honestly, no capability id is cited anywhere, no phrase 'capability exercised' or 'preview journey passed' appears, contracts/release-contract/** is untouched, .agents/v2/evidence/V2-022-release-live-dogfood.json is untouched, no Provider CLI was started and no Google Cloud resource was touched. checks.summary: A3 THE RULE EXISTS, IT IS ASYMMETRIC, AND IT LICENSES EXACTLY ONE PARENT TRANSITION. Every line number the Work Order gives for these quotes is CORRECT as measured. docs/architecture/domain-model.md:266 (the `active` row of the Requirement lifecycle table) verbatim: '| `active` | 1つ以上のIncrementが進行中 | `evaluating`, `waiting`, `needs-input`, `paused`, `recovering`, `cancelled` |'. That is a DEFINITION of the status, not a hint: the parent is active precisely because a subordinate Increment is in progress, so the ready->active edge is licensed by Increment progress and by nothing else -- and it licenses it in exactly the transaction that puts an Increment into progress, which is Service.Claim. domain-model.md:265 verbatim: '| `ready` | 優先順位評価済みで実行可能 | `active`, `waiting`, `paused`, `cancelled` |' -- ready is the completion of framing, which is why edge one's target is right. domain-model.md:101 verbatim: '1 Requirementに複数Incrementを許す。Incrementが成功してもRequirementは自動完了しない。' -- the opposite direction is REFUSED. domain-model.md:272 verbatim: '| `completed` | 対応Stable ReleaseとEvidenceで課題解決を確認 | 終端。新feedbackは新Requirement |'. docs/product/definition.md:104-105 verbatim: 'システム上の改善完了は、対象変更が / Previewで実証され、Stableへ昇格した時点とする。' and definition.md:130 verbatim: '- 完了を自己申告だけで決めず、要求と不変条件を検証する'. CONCLUSION recorded as this task's reading, and it matches dp-v2-084 d2: the rule licenses exactly ONE parent transition -- start (ready->active), derived inside the claim transaction -- and forbids the parent's completion and any advance on Prepare, Start, Checkpoint, AcceptResult or release. There is no disagreement to escalate.

checks.name: a13-ii-cancel-is-a-control-plane-design
